title: Writing Clean Node.js Code
overview: Clean code improves readability, maintainability, and reduces errors in Node.js applications.

example.title: Clean Code Practices
example.content:
✔ Meaningful names
✔ Small functions
✔ Remove duplicate code
✔ Follow consistent formatting

title: Project Folder Structure
overview: A proper folder structure separates different responsibilities and makes large applications easier to manage.

example.title: Backend Structure
example.content:
project/
 ├── controllers/
 ├── routes/
 ├── models/
 ├── services/
 └── utils/

title: Environment Variables
overview: Environment variables store sensitive configuration values like database URLs, API keys, and secrets.

title: Security Best Practices
overview: Node.js applications should follow security practices to protect user data and prevent attacks.

example.title: Security Practices
example.content:
✔ Validate input
✔ Protect passwords
✔ Use HTTPS
✔ Secure API endpoints

title: Performance Optimization
overview: Optimizing Node.js applications improves speed, scalability, and resource usage.

example.title: Optimization Methods
example.content:
✔ Use caching
✔ Optimize database queries
✔ Avoid blocking operations
